items.description:
SG Studio Architecture and Interior Design is a team of architects and interior designers specialising in bespoke, high-end luxury residential projects, with more than a decade of experience in the construction industry. The studio combines architectural planning with interior design under one roof, taking a project from design concept through to construction with an emphasis on premium finishes and class-leading craftsmanship in every detail.

Collaboration sits at the centre of how the studio works: ideas are developed together with clients and project partners to produce homes that are tailor-made rather than off-the-shelf, with a fresh, creative approach to layout and aesthetics. It serves clients building or renovating high-end residential homes from its base in Rietvalleirand, Pretoria, and is suited to homeowners who want a single, experienced team managing both the architecture and the interiors of their dream home.

Sinoville Fencing Rosslyn (Pty) Ltd traces its roots back to 1969, when Sinoville Fencing first began trading, and has since grown into a well-established name in the fencing and structural steel industry across Southern Africa. The Rosslyn branch, based in Klerksoord, Akasia, forms part of a wider group that also includes Sinoville Projects and Sinostruct, run from the same premises and offering related project and structural steel services.

Operating alongside sister branches in the Western Cape, Springbok, Kathu, Tubatse and the Highveld, the Rosslyn operation draws on more than five decades of combined experience in the sector. From its Akasia base, the business serves residential, agricultural, commercial and industrial clients in and around Pretoria needing fencing and structural steelwork, backed by the scale and track record of a long-running, multi-branch South African company.

SnA Architects is a Pretoria-based practice of architects, interior designers and project managers working across corporate, retail, educational, residential and industrial projects. The team holds GreenStar SA Professional accreditation and has built up expertise in master planning and space planning, drawing on experience with developers and property owners to balance design quality, budget and programme on each project.

The practice has been recognised with a SAPOA merit award and was a finalist in the 4SA Sustainable Design awards, and its project list includes work such as the Fincorp Mbabane development and a Silvermall refurbishment. A sister company, SNA Interiors & Projects, extends the practice's reach into dedicated project management and interior decoration and procurement. Based in De Wilgers, Pretoria, SnA Architects suits clients needing an integrated architecture, interiors and project-management service from a single, award-recognised team.

SnA Architects operates from Die Wilgers, Pretoria, as a practice of architects, interior designers and project managers covering corporate, retail, educational, residential and industrial work. Its team is GreenStar SA Professional accredited and has developed particular expertise in master planning and space planning, built on years of working closely with property owners and developers across a wide range of building typologies.

The practice's work has earned it a SAPOA merit award and finalist status in the 4SA Sustainable Design awards, with projects including the Fincorp Mbabane development and a Silvermall refurbishment. SNA Interiors & Projects, a sister company based alongside it, provides a dedicated project-management and interior-decoration service for clients who want procurement and fit-out handled under the same roof. The practice is suited to corporate, retail and educational clients looking for an architecture firm with a demonstrated design and delivery track record.

items.description:
Speciality Waterproof & Roof is a Pretoria and Centurion roofing specialist offering torch-on waterproofing, roof painting, roof repairs and maintenance, and commercial roof repair work. The business also carries out roof inspections and certificates of compliance, including drone-based roof inspections, and applies airless spray roof painting at a controlled 160-micron thickness backed by a 10-year guarantee.

The team works across Pretoria East and Centurion, covering areas such as Waterkloof, Montana, Menlyn, Groenkloof, Menlo Park, Mooikloof, Rooihuiskraal and Silver Lakes Golf Estate, with torch-on roof waterproofing offered from an entry-level price point for smaller jobs. Based in Tijger Valley, Pretoria, the business suits homeowners and commercial property owners needing roof leak repairs, waterproofing or a full roof repaint, with drone inspection used to assess problem areas before work begins.

Square One Consulting is a business solutions consultancy that helps organisations use data-driven insights to make better operational and strategic decisions. Its services are grouped around people, process and technology: workforce management work aimed at building adaptable, resilient teams; assessment and optimisation of business processes to cut wasted time and resource costs; and outcomes-based digital transformation projects built on cloud, AI and cybersecurity technology.

The consultancy works with both public and private sector clients, positioning itself as a guide through periods of organisational change, market shift and accelerating technology adoption. Operating from Claudius, Centurion, Square One Consulting is suited to organisations that need an outside partner to align their workforce, processes and technology systems rather than tackling digital transformation with a single, narrow fix.

Steri-Pools is a Mayville-based pool company offering a full range of swimming pool services, from building new pools to repairs, renovations and upgrades of older pools. Day-to-day care includes regular cleaning, water testing and chemical balancing, pump and filter servicing and repair, and leak and suction-problem detection, while larger jobs cover fibreglass and marbelite finishing, remarbelite work and paving and grouting repairs around the pool area.

The business offers both once-off pool care and monthly maintenance contracts, giving clients the choice between an occasional clean-up and an ongoing service plan. Beyond pools themselves, Steri-Pools extends into general property care such as paving, giving it a broader role for homeowners in and around Mayville, Pretoria who want one contractor for pool maintenance and related outdoor repairs.

Sterling Pharmaceuticals (Pty) Ltd is a privately owned, proudly South African pharmaceutical contract manufacturer operating from a modern GMP facility commissioned in 2021. The facility is built to current Good Manufacturing Practice guidelines and uses modern production technology to turn out reliable, consistent pharmaceutical products for the clients who contract its manufacturing services.

Its capabilities cover sachet filling, hard-gelatine and vegicap capsule encapsulation, and capsule counting into containers, giving pharmaceutical brands a local, GMP-compliant partner for producing finished dosage forms at scale. Operating from Olievenhoutbosch, Centurion, Sterling Pharmaceuticals positions itself around quality, consistency, reliability and service, and is suited to pharmaceutical companies that need contract manufacturing capacity rather than running their own production facility.

items.description:
Suppsco Skin & Hair is an online skincare and haircare retailer stocking professional, medical-grade brands including Bioderma, Biretix, Colorescience, Dermaceutic, Dermalogica, Dermexcel and Endocare. The site caters to both everyday shoppers and skincare practices, with a separate registration option for practitioners alongside the standard retail account, reflecting its focus on clinical-grade rather than mass-market skincare lines.

Retail customers receive free samples and free shipping on orders over R500, making it a practical option for stocking up on specialist skincare and haircare ranges without visiting a clinic in person. Based in Zwavelpoort, Pretoria, Suppsco operates primarily as an online store, serving customers across South Africa who are looking for specific professional skincare brands rather than general pharmacy or supermarket skincare ranges.

Sutherland Printing Co. is a Pretoria printing business covering a wide span of work, from label printing for bottles, buckets and stationery to window and floor graphics, vehicle branding and wide-format printing such as banners and posters. It also produces promotional print material including flyers, brochures and marketing collateral, along with wall decor and custom product packaging.

The business works with customers who need their branding applied physically, whether that is a logo wrapped across a vehicle, graphics printed onto a shopfront window or floor, or a short run of packaging for a product line. Operating from Boardwalk Manor in Faerie Glen, Pretoria, Sutherland Printing Co. suits businesses that need a single printer able to handle both small promotional items and larger-format signage and vehicle graphics.

Sweet Celebrations manufactures and supplies cake-decorating and baking ingredients, including fondant, cake premix, gum paste, frosting and gel food colouring, sold in sizes ranging from small 500g packs up to bulk 12.5kg quantities for commercial bakers. The range also covers whipping cream powder, cupcake wrappers and baking basics such as castor sugar, icing sugar and cocoa powder.

Proudly South African and produced to Halaal standards certified by SANHA, the business supplies both home bakers and bakeries that need consistent, certified ingredients for cakes and baked goods. Operating from Willow Glen, Pretoria, Sweet Celebrations is geared toward anyone from hobby cake decorators to small bakery businesses looking for a dependable, locally made source of fondant, gum paste and related cake-decorating supplies.

Synopsis Group is an ICT consulting business that helps companies work out how much of their operation can move onto secure, cloud-hosted and remote-enabled technology, and what that would mean for their budget, scalability and data security. Rather than a one-size-fits-all package, the consultancy works through questions about which services can run without face-to-face contact and what information needs to be protected, before recommending a fitting solution.

The business also offers web hosting alongside its consulting work, giving clients a single point of contact for both strategy and the infrastructure that supports it. Operating from Doornpoort, Pretoria, Synopsis Group is aimed at businesses preparing their technology and remote-work setup for both the local South African market and international operations.

The Infinite Team runs team-building programmes for corporate groups in and around Pretoria, ranging from recreational activities through to adventure sports and more structured team-development exercises. Its approach is built on experiential learning: hands-on activities designed to open up communication between team members and build unity by working through problems together in a safe, simulated environment rather than in the pressure of the real workplace.

Programmes are hosted at a variety of team-building-friendly venues around Pretoria and can be run year-round given the local climate, and are designed to slot alongside a conference, company function or outdoor excursion. Based in Annlin, the business suits corporate clients looking to combine a function or conference with a structured team-building component rather than booking the two separately.

Teraoka SA supplies and services weighing and labelling equipment from its branch at Montana Value Centre in Montana Park, serving both retail supermarkets and food manufacturers. The range covers portion scales, price-computing and printing scales, PC scales, counting scales and light industrial and platform scales, along with automatic wrapping machines, digital signage and electronic shelf labels, price-card solutions and markdown solutions.

Teraoka positions itself as a leading supplier in this field, citing a retail weighing-equipment market share of more than 70 percent on its own website. From its Montana Park branch, the business supports both the retail side, from small portion scales to full wrapping and labelling lines, and industrial and carcass-weighing equipment for food producers, making it a specialist supplier rather than a general electronics retailer.

Tersus GNSS South Africa supplies high-precision GNSS RTK positioning equipment for surveying, mapping, drones and precision agriculture, operating from InsideOut Rockfields in Rooihuiskraal North, Centurion. Its products include lightweight RTK modules built for large-scale drone deployment, giving unmanned aerial vehicles the centimetre-level positioning accuracy needed for aerial survey and drone-delivery work, alongside GNSS receivers and OEM boards used in surveying equipment to speed up both data collection and post-processing in the field.

The business also supplies guidance and steering solutions for farm machinery, allowing tractors to automate tasks such as ploughing, seeding, spraying and harvesting with greater precision, and provides GNSS RTK components used in autonomous-vehicle navigation systems. It serves surveying professionals, drone operators, farmers and vehicle-automation developers looking for centimetre-accurate positioning technology rather than general consumer GPS equipment.

The Blank Canvas Print & Design is a Pretoria printing business covering everything from signage and business cards to larger print runs of books, files, flyers and posters. The range also stretches into more specialised finishing work, including canvas prints, letterheads, notepads, foiling and laser cutting, giving it reach beyond standard office and marketing printing.

That combination of everyday stationery printing and finishing techniques such as foiling and laser cutting means the business can take on both routine print jobs and more decorative or branded pieces for a single client. Based in Moregloed, Pretoria, The Blank Canvas Print & Design suits individuals and businesses needing anything from a batch of business cards to a canvas print or a laser-cut, foiled finish on a promotional item.

items.description:
The Daily Coffee Café in Elardus Park is a branch of The Daily Coffee Café franchise, set in Elardus Park Shopping Centre in Pretoria East. Its interior draws on a self-described 'New York-meets-Karoo' styling, blending modern, striking décor with a calmer, more understated local feel, and the café is built around specialty coffee rather than a wider food-service menu.

Positioned as a neighbourhood coffee spot, it serves as a place for catching up with family and friends, holding informal business meetings, or simply taking some quiet time out over a cup of coffee. It is open Monday to Thursday from 7am to 5:30pm, Fridays until 6pm, Saturdays from 7:30am to 4pm and Sundays from 8am to 2pm, giving Elardus Park regulars a consistent daily spot for coffee as part of the wider Daily Coffee Café franchise network.

The GolfCart Company is a Centurion-based business specialising in golf cart maintenance, repair and customisation, backed by an in-house engineering shop that can fabricate parts and design new builds for custom requests. Services cover full engine and motor rebuilds, lithium-ion battery conversions, bodywork and custom paint jobs, upholstery, and lights and electrical work, alongside wheels, rims and suspension upgrades.

Beyond individual carts, the business also builds custom golf cart trailers and fits audio sound systems for customers wanting a more finished, personalised vehicle. Based in Zwartkop, the company positions itself around taking on builds that cannot simply be bought off the shelf, making it suited to golf cart owners wanting anything from routine servicing to a fully custom, engineered rebuild.

The Hadron Group supplies water treatment chemicals, disinfection products and analytical instrumentation used to test and manage water quality. Its range runs from laboratory equipment such as magnetic stirrers through to reagents and test tablets for specific measurements, including DPD-based chlorine testing, pH testing tablets and nitrite and manganese test kits, alongside dosing chemicals and chlorine-based disinfection products.

With several hundred individual analytical products alongside dedicated chemical and equipment categories, the business positions itself as a specialist supplier to laboratories, water treatment operators and industrial clients across South Africa rather than a general chemical wholesaler. Operating from Donkerhoek, Pretoria, The Hadron Group suits customers who need both the physical testing equipment and the reagents and chemicals that go with it from a single supplier.

The Laundry has been trading since 1982, when a small local laundry business was taken over and built into a dedicated garment rental and industrial laundry operation. Today it is run by the second generation of the same family, and provides compliant workwear and linen on a rental basis alongside professional laundry services for sectors including healthcare, hospitality, food production and manufacturing.

Its focus on managed garment rental means clients do not need to own or launder their own workwear and linen; instead, The Laundry supplies, cleans and maintains it as an ongoing service. Operating from a facility in Hermanstad, Pretoria, the business is geared toward companies that need consistently clean, compliant workwear and linen without running an in-house laundry themselves.

Timac AGRO South Africa supplies plant-nutrition products for farmers, part of a group that has worked in agricultural nutrition for more than 65 years and operates dozens of subsidiaries and production units internationally. Its range includes biostimulants such as Fertiactyl GZ, a liquid root and foliar product aimed at boosting early growth and root development, and Maxifruit, formulated to improve fruit setting and sizing under stress conditions.

On the fertiliser side, water-soluble products such as the KSC Phytactyl range are designed to correct nutrient deficiencies and support plant metabolism under stress, with versions suited to foliar application or fertigation across a range of crop types. Operating from Bronberrik, Centurion, Timac AGRO South Africa serves commercial farmers looking for science-backed soil and plant-nutrition products rather than generic fertiliser blends.

Toit Developments is a turnkey building and design company in La Montagne, Pretoria, covering a project from architectural design through to construction under one team. The business follows a three-stage plan, design and build process, with its own staff actively involved at every stage rather than handing off design and construction to separate contractors.

That hands-on involvement is positioned as a way of keeping the finished home aligned with what was originally planned, since the same team that designs the project also oversees its construction. Based in La Montagne, Toit Developments suits clients building a new home who want a single, accountable point of contact managing the project from first concept to completed build, rather than coordinating an architect and builder separately.

Torinet (Pty) Ltd is a Level 1 BBBEE company delivering project management and turnkey solutions across the construction and telecommunications industries in South Africa. Alongside its contracting and project-coordination work, the business manufactures and distributes emergency lighting and siren systems used by police, fire services, traffic authorities, SAPS, and towing, recovery and mining operators.

Torinet also runs a solar energy division, designing and supplying residential and commercial solar systems as part of a broader push into alternative green energy. Based in Kameeldrift East, Pretoria, the business is suited to clients needing specialised emergency-vehicle equipment or turnkey construction and telecoms project management, as well as those exploring solar power for a home or commercial site.

Trail-Link manufactures and distributes trailer electrical components, including suzis, plugs, sockets, constant-power braking coils and anti-kink air coils, along with a range of LED lighting products and underbody accessories for trailers and towing vehicles. Its range also covers high-amp-rating products built to military (NATO) specification, aimed at heavier-duty applications beyond standard road trailers.

The business distributes Aspöck vehicle lighting systems alongside its own Trail-Link LED range and recreational trailer solutions, and operates a distributor network that customers can search by region to find a local stockist. With operations spanning South Africa and Australia, Trail-Link, based in Eloffsdal, Pretoria, serves trailer manufacturers, fitment centres and the wider transport industry looking for electrical connectors and lighting built specifically for trailers rather than general automotive parts.

Trans African Concessions manages and maintains the N4 Toll Route, the Build-Operate-Transfer road connecting Gauteng to Maputo, Mozambique, through the Maputo Corridor. Alongside toll collection and road maintenance, the company runs a 24-hour emergency assistance line for motorists on the route and prioritises road safety as a core part of its operations.

Through its TRAC CARES programme, the business also supports communities along the N4 corridor, backing initiatives in environmental protection, enterprise development, education, sport, culture and health and welfare. The route itself passes through scenic and historically significant stretches of countryside, with leisure stops, nature activities and eateries along the way. Based at Blue Valley Golf Estate, Pretoria, Trans African Concessions positions itself as both a toll-road operator and a long-term partner to the communities the N4 passes through.

Tree Felling Pretoria East is a fully insured tree-care business with around seven years in the trade, covering tree felling and removal, stump removal, palm tree removal, and tree trimming and pruning. It also offers an emergency tree removal service for situations that need a quicker response than a standard booking.

The business provides free quotes and aims to respond to enquiries within a day, and includes clean-up of cut material and debris as part of the job rather than leaving it for the customer to clear. Based in Lynnwood Glen, Pretoria, Tree Felling Pretoria East is suited to homeowners needing anything from routine pruning to the removal of a large or hazardous tree, with the same team handling the felling and the clean-up that follows.

TSRM Africa is a multidisciplinary professional services firm offering audit and assurance, accounting and bookkeeping, business rescue, and management consulting to private, public and non-profit clients across Southern Africa. Its audit work is aligned with relevant regulatory frameworks, while its accounting and bookkeeping services are tailored to SMEs, NGOs and public entities, covering financial reporting and tax compliance.

The firm's registered business rescue practitioners handle turnaround and restructuring support under the Companies Act, and its management consulting covers strategy, governance and performance-improvement work. TSRM Africa also runs a range of professional training programmes, from project management and municipal finance to supply chain and community development practitioner courses. Operating from Forest Hill City in Monavoni, Centurion, the firm suits organisations needing combined accounting, advisory and training support rather than separate specialist providers.

items.description:
Twist Electrical Supplies has traded as an electrical wholesaler in Pretoria North since opening in July 2011, supplying electrical products and accessories to the construction industry, electrical contractors, and commercial and domestic customers. The business was started by a qualified electrician with more than 25 years in the electrical wholesale trade, and has since grown to include branches in Rosslyn and Langebaan in the Western Cape.

Long-term relationships with established suppliers underpin the wholesaler's pricing and stock availability, allowing it to respond quickly when customer requirements change. From its Pretoria North base, Twist Electrical Supplies serves customers ranging from electrical contractors fitting out a building site to homeowners needing parts for a domestic job, open Monday to Thursday from 7am to 5pm, Fridays until 4:30pm and Saturdays from 8am to 1pm.

Tyris Construction (Pty) Ltd has worked in the construction industry for more than 30 years, delivering residential, commercial, industrial and civil projects across South Africa. The company holds Level 1 BBBEE, ISO 9001 and ISO 45001 certification alongside NHBRC and CIDB registration, reflecting formal accreditation in both quality and safety management as well as the statutory registrations required for building work in South Africa.

Its project history includes the roughly R20 million PNA Warehouse in Benoni, completed for Ligthelm On Fourth in October 2022, and The Landmark 2 development in Randburg for Africrest Properties. Based in Shere, Pretoria, Tyris Construction is suited to clients needing an accredited contractor for larger commercial or industrial builds, with a track record of repeat business from its existing clients and sub-contractors.

Ubuntu Technologies is a South African ICT systems integrator established in 1997 in Bloemfontein as an empowered ICT company, since grown into a national provider headquartered in Pretoria. The business designs, deploys and maintains a broad spread of technology infrastructure, including networking, structured cabling, security systems and unified communications, alongside audio-visual installation and training for AV and collaboration environments.

On the software and applications side, it handles business application design and deployment for platforms such as SAP and Oracle, including robotic process automation implementations, and offers cloud services and telecommunications solutions to support remote and hybrid ways of working. Operating from Erasmuskloof, Pretoria, Ubuntu Technologies is open Monday to Thursday from 8am to 4:30pm and Fridays from 8am to 1pm, serving clients needing an established, long-running ICT partner rather than a newer start-up integrator.

Ultimate Sky is an events venue in Montana, Pretoria, offering a dedicated wedding celebration garden, reception space and bridal suite alongside self-catering accommodation with its own living rooms and kitchens for guests staying over. Its wedding packages are pitched as all-inclusive, covering the venue, catering and related event elements for couples planning their reception.

Beyond weddings, the venue hosts corporate functions such as conferences, business dinners and year-end events, as well as private functions including birthdays, anniversaries, reunions and retirement send-offs, each with access to a dedicated entrance, bar and restrooms rather than shared facilities. Garden space fitted with sound equipment also supports picnics and outdoor gatherings. Based in Montana Gardens, Ultimate Sky suits anyone planning a wedding, private celebration or corporate event who wants a single venue handling both the function space and overnight accommodation.

Unisa IRENE Conferencing Centre is a conference venue on the Unisa Irene campus in Doringkloof, used for business meetings and workshops as well as social events such as parties and weddings. Reviewers describe it as a clean, well-run venue removed from the busier parts of the city, which suits groups wanting a quieter setting for a meeting or function.

The centre offers ample on-site parking, which reviewers note makes it practical for larger events, along with security patrols across the grounds. Situated in Doringkloof, Centurion, Unisa IRENE Conferencing Centre is suited to organisations and individuals looking for a straightforward, secure venue for anything from a business workshop to a wedding reception, without the cost or scale of a dedicated hotel conference facility.

Urban Skips provides skip-bin hire across Pretoria and Centurion, working with 4 and 6 cubic-metre containers rather than smaller bins. The skips are used mainly for three types of job: building and construction rubble such as soil, bricks, mortar waste and scrap metal; garden refuse and home-renovation debris including tree and garden waste, old concrete and general cleanup rubbish; and rubble from painting and other exterior work around a property.

Customers book a skip sized to the job rather than being limited to a single bin size, which suits anything from a small home renovation to a larger construction or landscaping project. Operating from Kameeldrift, Pretoria, Urban Skips serves both domestic and commercial clients across the Pretoria and Centurion area who need rubble or garden waste removed without arranging their own transport to a disposal site.

VDT Attorneys Inc is a Pretoria-based law firm established in 1932, giving it more than 90 years of history as one of South Africa's longer-running legal practices. It has grown a national footprint while remaining headquartered in Pretoria, with practice areas spanning litigation and dispute resolution, property and conveyancing, commercial law, and estates and fiduciary services.

Its long operating history has allowed the firm to build relationships with significant clients over several decades, built around what it describes as integrity, trust and independence as guiding principles. Based at Waterkloof Ridge in Pierre van Ryneveld Park, Pretoria, VDT Attorneys is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 4:30pm, and suits individuals and businesses needing an established firm with depth across multiple areas of law rather than a single-specialty practice.

Vianto Property Management is a family-run property business in Dorandia, Pretoria North, with more than 17 years in property sales, rentals and management. Its services cover selling and letting of properties as well as ongoing management work, from rent collection and maintenance to the broader oversight needed across a property's life cycle.

The business manages commercial, industrial and residential real estate on behalf of owners, handling the day-to-day responsibilities of a rented or managed property so landlords do not have to. Being family-run, Vianto places particular emphasis on maintaining a personal relationship with clients while still keeping the professionalism expected of a property management business. Based in Dorandia, the company suits property owners in Pretoria North who want a local, long-established manager for letting and maintaining their property rather than a large corporate agency.

items.description:
We Buy Laptops purchases used laptops directly from the public through a structured four-step process. Sellers start by submitting photos and details of their device online and receive an initial offer, then, if they accept, the business collects the laptop for an in-store inspection before confirming a final offer based on its actual condition.

Once a final offer is accepted, the sale is completed in line with the requirements of the Second-Hand Goods Act, with the relevant documentation checked before payment is made by bank transfer. Operating from Bergtuin, Pretoria, We Buy Laptops is aimed at individuals who want to sell a used laptop without listing it privately, offering collection and a formal, documented buying process in its place.

We Do All Catering Equipment & Refrigeration sells, repairs, maintains and installs equipment for the bakery, butchery, catering and refrigeration trades. Its work extends to the design and installation of extraction systems, giving it a role beyond just supplying appliances into setting up the ventilation that commercial kitchens need to operate.

The business serves the wider hospitality sector, including pubs, hotels, canteens, nightclubs and restaurants that rely on reliable catering and refrigeration equipment to stay operational. Based in Pretoria West, the company is open Monday to Friday from 8:30am to 4:30pm and closed over weekends, and suits hospitality and food-service operators needing both new equipment and ongoing repairs and maintenance from one supplier.

We Do Digital is a digital marketing agency offering a wide span of services, from search engine optimisation and PPC marketing through to newer areas such as generative engine optimisation, alongside more conventional web design, copywriting and graphic design work. It also runs email, WhatsApp and social media marketing campaigns for clients who need their digital presence managed across several channels at once.

Beyond marketing execution, the agency provides consulting services covering strategy, audits and analytics, as well as public relations, photography and videography, and training for client teams who want to build in-house digital skills. Based in The Willows, Pretoria, We Do Digital works with businesses ranging from startups to larger organisations that need either a single specialist service or a fuller digital marketing function handled externally.

Wenbro Hire Silverton hires, sells, repairs and manufactures construction equipment, with a range that covers compaction rammers, plate and pedestrian compactors, ride-on rollers, air compressors, generators, welders and concrete mixers. Manufacturing its own equipment alongside hiring and selling third-party machinery gives the business more control over repairs and parts availability than a pure hire company.

Operating branches in Pretoria and Polokwane, Wenbro Hire supplies contractors and homeowners across Gauteng and Limpopo needing anything from a single compactor for a weekend job to ongoing equipment supply for a larger site. The Silverton branch is open Monday to Thursday from 7:30am to 5pm, Fridays until 4pm and Saturdays until 11am, closed on Sundays, serving the Pretoria construction and hire market from its Buckle Street premises.

Wierda Park Pets is a pet shop in Wierdapark, Centurion, stocking products for dogs, cats and other household pets, sourced from what it describes as reputable brands that meet set quality and safety standards. Staff provide personalised advice and recommendations on pet care rather than leaving customers to choose products without guidance.

The shop changed local ownership in September 2024 and has continued operating as a community-focused pet store, taking part in local pet-related events and supporting animal welfare organisations alongside its retail operation. Based in Wierdapark, Wierda Park Pets suits pet owners looking for a neighbourhood store with knowledgeable staff and a broad product range, rather than a large chain pet retailer.
